'''2018 European MPC Results Floris de Vries LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Floris de Vries]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Boss Nass|Theed-L-bossnass.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Vries LS 2018 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
